Learning lab · KYC multi-agent system

Agent Test Explorer

How agentic AI is tested, shown on 125 test results for a KYC onboarding assistant (a Supervisor and four specialist agents). Open a card to see how data flowed, what each agent decided, the path it took against the expected path, which tools it chose, and which assertions passed. Blue notes translate each idea into .NET and traditional QA terms.

Mock data.Generated for learning from the real case suite and synthetic data. Statuses, decisions, confidences and timings are not measured results.
